outputs.Decision_and_explanation: FAIL - The top plot in panel C is a box-and-whisker plot showing total polyp number per mouse, but the caption only states 'The mean numbers and sizes of intestinal polyps... at 4 months of age (n=8-18 per genotype)' and gives significance levels without ever defining what the box, median line, or whiskers represent (e.g., quartiles, min/max, SD).

FAIL - The bar chart of GTP-bound Rac1/Cdc42 levels shows error bars (caps above bars), but the caption describes only the pulldown methodology and does not state what the error bars represent (e.g., SD, SEM, number of replicates).

FAIL - The 'Relative expression' bar chart (Asef, pJNK1, MMP9) shows error bars with significance asterisks, but the caption only describes the blotting/zymography experiment and loading controls without defining the error bars (e.g., SD, SEM) or the statistical test basis.
